psd_obstruction.case_anchor_null: For x with x^T SigmaHat x<0, if x^T Sigma0 x=0 then C=SigmaHat-Sigma0 has an out-of-support component and no Gaussian Stein transport exists.
psd_obstruction.case_anchor_positive: If x^T Sigma0 x>0, then (x^T C x)/(x^T Sigma0 x)=(x^T SigmaHat x)/(x^T Sigma0 x)-1<-1, so Sigma0+epsilon*C becomes singular before epsilon=1.
psd_obstruction.conclusion: No PSD anchor can turn the measured indefinite SigmaHat into a lawful unit-amplitude covariance path.
